newsitem.title: USA: Bridger Wyo. coal-fired unit seen off-line by Fri.
newsitem.headline: Bridger Wyo. coal-fired unit seen off-line by Fri.

text.p: The 550 megawatt (MW) unit 1 at the Jim Bridger coal-fired plant in Rock Springs, Wyo., is likely to go off-line Friday, or possibly before then, for unplanned maintenance work, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Wedneday.
Operations of the unit are described as shaky, but efforts are being made to keep it running until the weekend, when power demand typically wanes.
Frigid weather along with the unplanned outage of a 700 MW coal-fired unit at the Colstrip generating plant in Montana have caused spot power prices to nearly double this week.
Last week, another of the Bridger plant's four 550 MW units was out of service for a couple days for tube repairs.
Officials at PacifiCorp, the plant's majority owner and operator, would not comment on power plant operations.
